name: Clone Smart List
summary: Makes a copy of a smart list into a new name and folder.
whenToUse: When you want to reuse an existing list's logic without touching the original.

fields.name: name
fields.label: New list name
fields.hint: Must be unique in the instance.

fields.name: folder
fields.label: Destination folder
fields.hint: Must be a Program or a smart-list folder — JSON object with id and type.

response.description: The new cloned smart list record.

notes: Marketo expects this call as form-urlencoded (not JSON) — the utility handles that automatically.
